fees.description: Disconnection fee - applicable when energy is disconnected to the property.
Reconnection fee - applicable when energy is reconnected to the property.
Special meter read (including moving in and moving out of your supply address).
Late Payment Fee may be applied, if applicable (GST is not applicable).
Direct Debit Rejection Fee (GST is not applicable).
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by credit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.
Payment processing fee may apply to payments made by debit card (GST inclusive). Not applicable after 1 October 2026.

electricityContract.terms: A copy of the Market Retail Contract is provided and can be seen on our website. Refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/your-rights-and-obligations.

discounts.description: All customers will receive a 8% discount off their electricity supply and usage charges, applied to each quarterly electricity invoice for a benefit period of 12 months. Discount does not apply to any Greenchoice electricity charges, or miscellaneous fees and charges; and will not apply to any government taxes, fees, levies or charges. For further information, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/NSW-Standard-electricity-prices-July-2026.
discounts.displayName: Discount off supply and usage charges

electricityContract.variation: If we vary our market offer prices or miscellaneous fees and charges, we will notify you at least five business days before the variation in the tariffs and charges are to apply to you; and deliver the notice by your preferred form of communication where you have communicated this to us, or otherwise by the same method as that used for delivery of your bill.

timeOfUseRates.description: From 7am to 1pm and 8pm to 10pm on business days

singleRate.description: Available for restricted periods not exceeding a total of 17 hours in any period of 24 hours

electricityContract.onExpiryDescription: The benefit period is 1 year. At the end of your benefit period you may be placed on a new pricing plan. We will notify you of any changes at least 20 business days before they take effect.
electricityContract.additionalFeeInformation: For information on additional fees, refer to https://www.actewagl.com.au/legal/pricing-information/charges-and-rates.
